successCriteria.description: LeaveBalance interface defined in src/modules/leave/leave-balance.model.ts with all required attributes: id, employeeId, policyId, totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays, pendingDays, fiscalYear, status (BalanceStatus enum imported from src/shared/types/index.ts), createdAt, updatedAt

ILeaveBalanceRepository interface defined with methods: findById(id: string): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>, findByEmployeeId(employeeId: string): Promise<LeaveBalance[]>, findByEmployeeAndPolicy(employeeId: string, policyId: string, fiscalYear: number): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>, create(balance: Omit<LeaveBalance, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<LeaveBalance>, update(id: string, balance: Partial<Omit<LeaveBalance, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>>): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>, upsert(balance: Omit<LeaveBalance, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<LeaveBalance>
LeaveBalanceRepository class extends BaseRepository<LeaveBalance> and implements ILeaveBalanceRepository, with constructor accepting optional poolOverride: Pool
upsert uses ON CONFLICT (employee_id, leave_policy_id, fiscal_year) DO UPDATE to handle insert-or-update atomically

Jest unit tests at tests/unit/modules/leave/leave-balance.repository.test.ts covering all repository methods (findById, findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeAndPolicy, create, update, upsert) with both success and edge cases (null returns, empty arrays, no-op updates, conflict vs insert)

constraints: All database access must go through the repository pattern (GP-001) — LeaveBalanceRepository extends BaseRepository and uses pool.query; no inline SQL in models or elsewhere
outOfScope: Leave balance business logic (balance arithmetic, state transitions, pending-days enforcement) — deferred to Phase 6 (Leave service)

ambiguities.description: The reconciled architecture (ARCHITECTURE.md) defines BalanceStatus as ACTIVE | EXHAUSTED | FROZEN | ROLLED_OVER, but src/shared/types/index.ts (Phase 1) only exports Active | Exhausted | Frozen — no RolledOver. The LeaveBalance model and repository use the three-value enum from the source file. This is a pre-existing gap from Phase 1, not introduced by Phase 4, but may affect future phases that expect ROLLED_OVER.
options: Accept the three-value enum as-is and add ROLLED_OVER in a later phase when needed
Add RolledOver to BalanceStatus in Phase 1's types file now
